items.title: Disney Targets $3 Billion in Cost Savings and Weighs a Free Disney+ Tier as Asia Parks Weaken
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDisney beat fiscal fourth-quarter estimates, raised its dividend 33% and set a goal of about $3 billion a year in cost savings by fiscal 2029. Its double-digit EPS growth guide for fiscal 2027 leans on cost cuts and buybacks as its Asia parks stay weak through 2027.

items.title: Mickey Mouse Ready To Layoff Workers
items.summary: Disney crushed earnings, raised its dividend, and still watched investors shrug. The reason has little to do with the quarter and everything to do with the kind of businesses Wall Street thinks Disney is stuck in.

items.title: Disney Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates, Revenues Rise Y/Y
items.summary: DIS' Q4 fiscal 2026 earnings beat estimates as revenues rise 16%, fueled by strong Entertainment, Sports and Experiences growth. What's ahead for fiscal 2027?

items.title: Join The Club:  Fubo Stops Subscriber Disclosures
items.summary: The latest (and supposedly last) result has Fubo now at 5.75 million in the three-month period ending Sept. 30, down from 6.0 million North American subscribers in the year-ago period.

items.title: Disney Q4 Earnings Call Details Plans to Reinvest Savings
items.summary: Disney plans to reinvest roughly $3 billion savings annually by fiscal 2029 in content, technology and marketing while prioritizing streaming and Experiences.

items.title: Disney's Better-Than-Expected Q4 Results Put These ETFs in Focus
items.summary: Disney beats Q4 earnings estimates, driven by strong growth across its key business segments. Explore ETFs with significant exposure to DIS.

items.title: Netflix Just Hit a 52-Week Low. Where’s the Bottom?
items.summary: Netflix has shed nearly half its value from the peak, and ad cuts and a massive Warner Bros. bet are fueling the fear. Yet record buybacks and fat margins tell a different story, so which signal should investors trust?
